methodologyNotes: Fourteen photography softboxes spanning shoe-mount speedlight modifiers (Neewer, Impact) to strobe/monolight studio boxes (Profoto, Elinchrom, Godox, Aputure, Westcott, Phottix, Fotodiox, SmallRig, Selens) were verified directly against manufacturer sites (aputure.com, godox.com, elinchrom.com, fjwestcott.com, phottix.com, fotodioxpro.com, neewer.com) and authorized-retailer listings (B&H Photo Video, Amazon), with unconfirmed prices left null rather than estimated and two seed items on Adorama-exclusive house brands (Glow EZ Lock Deep Octa, Angler BoomBox) replaced by verified real alternatives (Westcott Rapid Box Switch Octa-S and 1x3) after adorama.com repeatedly returned a bot-verification wall on every fetch attempt. A prior 'Godox QR-P120T' substitution was removed on adversarial re-verification: godox.com lists only QR-P70/QR-P90/QR-P120 with no 'T' variant, so that entry was treated as unverifiable and dropped.

products.name: Aputure Light Dome III
products.priceNote: Aputure.com list price $219; listed at a reduced/sale price of $186 at time of check

specs.speedring_compatibility: Bowens mount; fits all Aputure Bowens-mount COB lights and third-party Bowens lights
specs.fabric: reflective interior with 16 heavy-duty steel support rods; quick-folding flat-pack hinged speedring

products.provenance: Aputure's own product page confirms 90cm/3ft 32-sided dome shape, Bowens mount, 2 included diffusion cloths (1-stop/2-stop), a 40-degree fabric grid included, 16 steel support rods, 2.24kg weight, and a collapsed size of 88x18x5cm. The page notes the model has since been superseded in Aputure's current lineup by the Quick Dome 90 but the product page and spec sheet remain live.

specs.mount_type: Elinchrom (Rotalux Speedring sold separately, item EL-26570)

products.provenance: SUBSTITUTED FOR SEED: the seed's exact model number "SmallRig RA-D85" could not be located on smallrig.com (the site's product catalog is JS-rendered and repeatedly returned only navigation-menu HTML to direct fetch, with no matching model page found). The current SmallRig 35in/90cm Bowens-mount quick-release octagon softbox, model LA-O90, was confirmed instead via its live Amazon listing (ASIN B0D3QHF71T, page title "SmallRig 35"/90cm Softbox LA-O90 Quick Release Octagon Soft Box"), priced $79.99 list / $67.99 sale, and is used as the real current SmallRig quick-release octagon product a buyer would find today. diffusion_layers and fabric were not stated in the retrieved page content, so left null.

products.name: Selens 34in/85cm Hexadecagon Softbox with Bowens Mount
products.provenance: NOTE ON SEED: the seed name "Selens Octabox" was matched to Selens's actual current product line, which is built and marketed as a 16-sided "Hexadecagon" softbox (a rounder, more octagon-like profile than a standard 8-panel octa) rather than a true 8-sided octabox; the 34in/85cm Bowens-mount version (ASIN B076K7GBLD) is used here, confirmed live on Amazon at $45.00 with a 4.5/5 rating across 25 reviews. diffusion_layers and fabric material were not itemized in the retrieved listing content, so left null.

specs.speedring_compatibility: Profoto native mount only; not Bowens/Elinchrom compatible without a third-party adapter
specs.fabric: silver reflective interior with a removable white front diffuser
